sources.snippet: Zephyr Tempest II: stainless steel body, stainless baffle filters (dishwasher safe), LED dimmable lighting, electronic 4+ speed control. Internal blower: 650 CFM. External blower option (BLB series): up to 1200 CFM with dramatically reduced noise at hood. Available in wall-mount and island configurations. 3-year warranty. Designed in San Francisco, manufactured in China.

sources.source_name: Kitchen design pros — Zephyr specification rationale
sources.snippet: Kitchen designers specify Zephyr for clients who want: (1) modern, clean-lined aesthetic that complements contemporary kitchens, (2) external blower option for noise-sensitive open-concept designs, (3) strong performance at lower price than Wolf/Vent-A-Hood. Zephyr is considered the sweet spot of design + performance. Weakness: China manufacturing means construction quality is good but not premium, and designers note body gauge is typically thinner than Vent-A-Hood or Wolf.
sources.classification_reason: Professional specification consensus with honest strength/weakness assessment

sources.snippet: Zephyr range hoods listed in HVI certified products directory with independently verified CFM and sone ratings for both internal and external blower configurations.

Repair tech reports: Zephyr motors are standard centrifugal units — not in the same class as Vent-A-Hood Magic Lung or Wolf ball-bearing motors. Adequate for typical residential use but will wear faster than premium options. External blower option is the real value play — moves the motor outside, extending hood-side longevity. Parts are available direct from Zephyr but not widely stocked at independent distributors.
sources.classification_reason: Repair tech honest assessment of motor quality relative to Tier 1

sources.snippet: Zephyr hoods tested with good airflow performance. Noise levels moderate with internal blower. External blower configuration dramatically reduces perceived noise at the hood position. Baffle filter effectiveness rated good.

Homeowners report Zephyr external blower (BLB series) installation adds $500-1200 to total cost but makes a dramatic difference in kitchen noise. Hood runs near-silent. Some owners report 3+ years of trouble-free operation. Common complaint: customer service can be slow and parts ordering process is not streamlined compared to Broan or Wolf.
sources.classification_reason: Owner experience with external blower and service ecosystem

sources.snippet: Zephyr Ventilation is a privately held company headquartered in San Francisco, California. Products designed in San Francisco and manufactured in partnership with Chinese OEM facilities. Company focuses on balancing design aesthetics with ventilation performance — positions itself as the design-forward alternative to traditional ventilation brands.

bottom_line: Zephyr Tempest II is the Tier 2 design-forward range hood with a critical differentiator: external blower availability. With internal blower, it delivers 650 CFM at moderate noise — competent but not exceptional. With BLB external blower, it can reach 1200+ CFM with near-silent hood operation. Stainless baffle filters, LED dimmable lighting, clean modern design. 26 luxury listing sightings confirms strong designer adoption. Weakness: China manufacturing means body construction is adequate but not Vent-A-Hood/Wolf caliber, and parts/service ecosystem is thinner.
